address: 16/10 Mu 1, Phet Kasem Road, Bang Nai Si, Takua Pa, Phang-Nga, 82110, Thailand
bio: Nearby the Takua Pa Government Office, this street food place serves Thai-Muslim dishes, including excellent chicken biryani, plus crispy rotis paired with savoury curries or sweet condensed milk and banana. Open for breakfast through late lunch, it closes when the food runs out....
